newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint eases vs dlr, BCE lira futures most popular.
newsitem.headline: Forint eases vs dlr, BCE lira futures most popular.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the dollar compared with Monday's opening but slightly higher than its midday low against the U.S. unit, dealers said.
"The forint tracked the dollar/mark during the afternoon session," said Adam Szilagyi of ABN AMRO.
The Hungarian unit closed at 167.65/70 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 167.50/60 and a midday low of 167.85/90.

The gap that separated the forint from the central bank's resistance level opened again to between 10 and 15 pips. Currency futures turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) rose to 3.63 billion forints from Friday's 3.13 billion.
Italian lira futures were the most popular, accounting for 15,000 contracts out of a total 25,341.
Dollar and sterling futures rose for all maturities, the German mark and the Swiss franc finished lower for most maturities while yen and Ecu futures closed mostly steady.
